annotations.title: Nordic Company Enricher for Google Maps

description: Enrich Google Maps scraper output with official registry data (org number, legal form, status, industry, employees) for companies in Norway, Finland, Denmark and Sweden. Runs automatically after any Google Maps scraper via Integrations. Charges only per successful match.

google_maps_dataset_id.description: ID of a Google Maps scraper (compass / crawler-google-places) dataset to enrich

max_rows_to_process.description: Cap on how many rows to read from the dataset

minimum_match_confidence_0_1.description: Only rows with a match confidence at or above this threshold are enriched and charged

name: nordic_maps_enricher
